$description: Type: the three faces, weights, leading and tracking, and the two scales (tool tier by default, marketing tier by class).

sans.$description:
── Type ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  --sans     Geist — body and headings, both tiers
  --mono     IBM Plex Mono — data that must read precise
  --display  Silkscreen — MARKETING TIER ONLY (monogram, hero eyebrows)

NOTE: Geist is not yet installed in `life` — only brignano.io
self-hosts it. Until added, the stack falls through to Inter and that
repo renders as before. Adding it is a deliberate separate change.

weight-regular.$description:
Weight, leading and tracking. Sizes are per tier (below); these are
not. Three weights, and nothing lighter or bolder.
(--weight-heavy is the one exception: the display treatment, .display
and .stamp, ADR-0014.) Leading is unitless
so it scales with the text: display for large headings, title for
titles, ui for interface text, body for paragraphs. Tracking
only ever tightens a heading or opens an uppercase mono eyebrow
(and the .stamp monogram, whose bar closes up otherwise).

Named by role, not tight/snug/normal: Tailwind owns those names
(--leading-tight, --tracking-tight) and an unlayered token here would
silently change what its utilities do in every consumer.

display-case.$description:
How the display treatment is set: a kit may ask for capitals and a wider
cut of its face (Split). `text-transform` and `font-stretch` read these.

leading-xs.$description:
── One line height and one tracking per size ──
A step of the scale is three tokens: --text-N, --leading-N, --tracking-N.
Each starts as the role token it used already, so nothing moves; a kit
retunes a step without touching the others.

text-xs.$description:
Tool-tier scale — compact, because scanning beats reading.
Declared BEFORE the marketing tier on purpose: `:root` and
`.tier-marketing` have the same specificity, so on <html> whichever
comes later wins. With this block last, the class did nothing.

root-not-tier-marketing-pointer-coarse.$description:
On a phone the tool tier's smallest step rises from 11px to 12px: fine
beside a mouse, too small at arm's length. The marketing tier's is
already 12px.

tier-marketing.$description:
── Marketing tier ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
`class="tier-marketing"` on <html> (brignano.io). Unlocks the display
face and opens the type scale. COLOUR IS IDENTICAL ACROSS TIERS — that
is the point of this file. Tool tier is the default.
